title: A Goofy Movie: Father-Son Road Trip Adventure
imageHint: Cartoon father and teenage son in a car on a road trip with camping gear and maps
description: Goofy tries to reconnect with his teenage son Max through an unforgettable cross-country road trip filled with mishaps, music, and heartfelt moments.

questions.question: What is the name of Goofy's teenage son?
questions.explanation: Max Goof is Goofy's teenage son who is embarrassed by his father and dreams of impressing his crush Roxanne.

questions.question: What singer does Max pretend to be at the school assembly?
questions.explanation: Max impersonates the pop star Powerline during a school assembly performance to impress Roxanne, which gets him in trouble with the principal.

questions.question: What is the name of Max's crush?
questions.explanation: Roxanne is Max's high school crush, and his desire to impress her drives much of the plot, including his lie about knowing Powerline personally.

questions.question: Where does Goofy originally plan to take Max on their road trip?
questions.explanation: Goofy plans a father-son fishing trip to Lake Destiny, but Max secretly changes their route to go to the Powerline concert in Los Angeles.

questions.question: What famous Powerline song do Goofy and Max sing together at the end?
questions.explanation: 'I2I' (Eye to Eye) is Powerline's hit song that becomes the emotional centerpiece when Goofy and Max finally connect and perform it together on stage.
